proposed_transition.residual: Verified: all-share renewal cycles with >=2 B-transitions are impossible of any length (B at position i forces r_i = u, so two B's collapse r_i = r_j = u). Remaining: cycles with <=1 B transition (all-A and single-B). The all-A 2-cycle collapses via telescoping injectivity but the all-A 3-cycle survives; determine whether a single B plus the unique-fixer/short-block coupling closes the remaining all-A and single-B clean cycles.

scope: all-share (u,b) renewal cycles; >=2 B-transitions; transition equations + distinct rows only (no injectivity, no E677/shadow/carrier/fixer axioms)
theorem: An all-share (u,b) Good-row A/B renewal cycle with >=2 B-transitions is UNSAT, of any length, without injectivity (B at position i forces r_i = u).
